Description: Recording system events and user actions for security auditing and compliance tracking
Reverting system to previous stable state when errors occur or transactions fail
Validating data reasonableness and system state consistency to detect anomalies early
Recognizes and handles faults through exception mechanisms, informing exception handlers of detected faults
Protects data from unauthorized modifications using encryption and decryption mechanisms
Avoids coupling between components to decrease modification range and prevent ripple effects
Enables late decision making and runtime modification by deferring binding time of components
Extends existing components through plug-in mechanism for smaller changes, higher productivity
